notes:
High-level summary:
- Large North American power transmission operator. Very conservative security posture; NERC CIP requirements and internal audit controls drive procurement.
- Want fully air-gapped Private deployment: no outbound internet, model artifacts must be signed and transferred via removable media or secure transfer node.
- Must support HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2) and local KMS; Redwood console should be optional and runnable inside customer control plane.
- No telemetry leaves site. Telemetry/tracing must be pluggable to customer SIEM (Splunk/QRadar) and kept for 7 years per policy.
- POC ask: 2-week offline evaluation in isolated lab using provided DGX hosts (4x A100-ish). Evaluate chat/operator-assist workflows, latency targets ~150ms p95 for 512-token sessions, throughput ~30 concurrent streams.
- Model constraints: prefer quantized open models; export-license review needed if specific weights used. Need ability to pin model versions and perform canary rollouts purely internally.
- Ops requirements: deterministic build artifacts, signed images, reproducible deployment scripts (Ansible/Terraform), CVE disclosure SLA, monthly patch window.
- Security team asked: sample SBOM, encryption-in-transit/at-rest proof, architecture diagram for offline upgrade process.
- Quote from CTO: "We need guarantees on no external callbacks — zero chance of telemetry or KV cache leakage."
- Procurement: running RFP in parallel; internal vendor scorecard favors vendors with onsite install and long-term support contracts.
- Commercial: prefixed toward a 3-year dedicated/private contract with hardware procurement assistance.
- Helpful artifacts: security questionnaire (sent 2026-02-09), NDA executed 2026-02-11, pricing deck link in Drive.
- Notes style: fragmentary — many follow-ups scheduled, legal + export teams engaged.
